negative_reviews.author: Sadat Shaik
negative_reviews.text: Too much time to get seated and to take order.

negative_reviews.author: Wong Maggie
negative_reviews.text: The onsen egg looks really weird and  noodles aren’t springy enough. I go to Japan three times a year, and I’ve never had   texture of that ramen noodles. Soup is fine.

negative_reviews.author: Pari Talwar
negative_reviews.text:
The pumpkin croquettes were delicious as well as the spicy chicken teriyaki!!!!!
Thank you so much to Diana for providing us with lovely service ♡

negative_reviews.author: Richard Garner
negative_reviews.text:
Mediocre food, not awful but unsuitable prices for the quality
I paid for a full pint but was only served half in a pint glass. I wouldn't return under current managment
